services.name: Morning Dolphin Watch & Snorkel Cruise with Lunch and Drinks
services.desc: Premier experience up the entire Waianae coast, filled with magical stories of our islands, and the legends and history of this beautiful land. Enjoy snorkeling in the pristine waters off Oahu's western coastline. We provide the best snorkeling equipment as you swim in the sparkling blue water of Makua amongst unspoiled reef and sea life where no other tours take 3.5 h • Meal & Drinks Included • Snorkel Gear Included • 8am

services.name: Sunset Dolphin Watch & Snorkel Cruise with Dinner and Cocktails
services.desc: Our Sunset Snorkel Cruise is the only Sunset Dinner Cruise that also takes you snorkeling. Learn about the magical history of our islands and the Waianae coastline as our crew enchants you with legends and history of this beautiful land. 3.5 Hours Included Gourmet Hawaiian meal with alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks Oahu tour is fully narrated in both English and Japanese Six showers with warm freshwater Make use of our very spacious and super clean changing rooms/toilets High-grade snorkel equipment with soft silicone seals, optical lenses, and quality fins provided as well 3.5 h • Meal & Drinks Included • Snorkel Gear Included • 4:15pm

services.desc: 3.5 Hours About Spend your private charter in O’ahu how you want and with who you want when you reserve the Kai ‘Oli’Oli all to yourselves! By chartering a private boat on Oahu, you can avoid the crowds and enjoy a more personalized and exclusive experience of Oahu’s stunning coastline and crystal-clear waters. Your knowledgeable and experienced captain will guide you to some of the most beautiful and hidden spots around the island. Whether you’re looking for a romantic sunset cruise, a fun family outing, or an adventurous excursion, a private Oahu charter can be tailored to exceed Up to 49 Guests • Cocktails & Beverages Included

quotes.text: We loved this whale/dolphin watching & snorkeling experience. The crew was fantastic and very knowledgeable. Loved the catamaran and the warm water to rinse off with after you were done snorkeling.
Our first time to Hawaii for our 5 yr old daughter's MAKE-A-Wish trip. We are so glad we chose this adventure. The crew was awesome. They were very informative, friendly, accommodating and funny.
I just came off of this cruise — it was AMAZING!!!! We saw dolphins, turtles and other sea life. Both while on the boat and snorkeling! It was one of the coolest experiences of my life!
